name: HoldCaptured
doc: The matching settlement/capture arrived (ADR-PC-033 slot 2): the hold leaves the active set (stops reducing the available balance); the posting Movement that moves the accounting balance rides its own Movement-bearing event, not this fact. A capture MAY be partial — captured_amount_cents less than the placed amount releases the remainder. DORMANT wire shape (the .avsc.json posture): the event is STORE-ONLY today (ADR-IC-017 — no named external consumer); bus promotion is renaming to .avsc plus the AsyncAPI catalog entry. Field names follow the engine codec convention. No PII (ADR-PC-004).

fields.name: instance_id
fields.doc: The account-owning instance (stream) the hold rides — a structural id, not PII.

fields.name: hold_id
fields.doc: The placed hold this capture releases (the ADR-PC-033 slot-4 lifecycle key).

fields.name: account_ref
fields.doc: The opaque account the earmark applied to — a reference, never PII.

fields.name: captured_amount_cents
fields.doc: The settled amount in integer cents — may be less than the placed amount (a partial capture releases the remainder).

fields.name: value_date
fields.doc: The economic date the capture settled — an input date, never a clock read.
